rationale: The agent authenticated the user via name and ZIP, pulled the user details, and checked multiple orders. It found no delivered laptop order and noted a discrepancy (user reports receipt while the system shows pending). The agent did not perform any order-changing write without confirmation, acted only on the user’s account, and appropriately escalated to a human when the request could not be handled due to inconsistent order status. The final handoff summary is accurate and supported by tool results. This meets the policy’s requirements.
